PRESCHOOL · AGE 4

Age 4: skills, stories, puzzles and getting ready to read.

Fifteen big classes for four- and five-year-olds — Transportation & Vehicles (Class 24), Shapes, Patterns & Sorting (Class 25), Colors, Mixing & Creativity (Class 26), Early Writing & Pencil Control (Class 27), Phonics & Beginning Sounds (Class 28), Storytime & Pre-Reading (Class 29), Logic, Thinking & Problem-Solving (Class 30), Science, Nature & Discovery (Class 31), Life Skills & Good Habits (Class 32), Community Helpers & Our Neighborhood (Class 33), Weather, Seasons & What We Wear (Class 34), Numbers, Counting & Early Math (Class 35), Animals & Their Habitats (Class 36), Sports, Movement & Play (Class 37) and Feelings & Kindness (Class 38) — each with its own shelf of real activities built on our own artwork.

Ages 4–5Class 24

Transportation & Vehicles

Thirty-two step-by-step spotter lessons — the everyday rides first, then the helpers, the rails, the water, the sky and eleven construction sheets — each card naming four labeled vehicles with a spotting game, plus the printable vehicles cards to sort by land, water and air.

Open Class 24 ↗
Age 4Class 25

Shapes, Patterns & Sorting

Nine shapes, three pattern games and the whole Shape Adventures shelf: a spaceship to build, a monster factory, candy sorting and a shape detective.

Open Class 25 ↗
Age 4Class 26

Colors, Mixing & Creativity

Real paint mixing, tap-to-fill coloring you can actually stay inside, movable decorations and a splatter canvas in the Colors & Creativity studio.

Open Class 26 ↗
Age 4Class 27

Early Writing & Pencil Control

Thirty on-screen tracing adventures in the Writing Adventures library — winding paths, loops, mazes and dot-to-dots with a finger, stylus or mouse.

Open Class 27 ↗
Ages 4–5Class 28

Phonics & Beginning Sounds

Twenty-four listening games with real recorded sound in the Phonics Adventures library — first sounds, rhymes, blending and sound swaps, plus a printable worksheet for every game, the A–Z letter-sound flashcards to print and sort, and twenty-six step-by-step letter-sound lessons opening at the Apple lesson.

Open Class 28 ↗
Ages 4–5Class 29

Storytime & Pre-Reading Comprehension

Twenty-nine draw-on-the-picture story adventures in the Storytime Adventures library — sequencing, clues, feelings and retelling, plus a printable worksheet for every story — and fifty-two sight word lessons with printable cards, all on the Sight Words hub.

Open Class 29 ↗
Ages 4–5Class 30

Logic, Thinking & Problem-Solving

Thirty draw-on-the-picture logic adventures in the Logic Adventures library — patterns, odd ones out, secret codes and one traceable maze, plus a printable worksheet for every puzzle.

Open Class 30 ↗
Ages 4–5Class 31

Science, Nature & Discovery

Thirty draw-on-the-picture science adventures in the Science Adventures library — plant growth, weather, insects, magnets, habitats, life cycles and a graduation lab, plus a printable worksheet for every experiment.

Open Class 31 ↗
Ages 4–5Class 32

Life Skills & Good Habits

Real activity sheets done right on the screen — wash your hands, tidy up, kind words, movement and asking for help — each with a printable twin in the Life Skills worksheets.

Open Class 32 ↗
Ages 4–5Class 33

Community Helpers & Our Neighborhood

Twenty-nine step-by-step helper lessons — doctor, firefighter, teacher, farmer, chef and the builders and fixers — each with the original flashcard artwork, parent scripts and a practice game, plus the Community Helpers flashcards and the 35 helper worksheets to print.

Open Class 33 ↗
Ages 4–5Class 34

Weather, Seasons & What We Wear

Twenty-nine step-by-step sky-and-clothes lessons — sun, clouds, rain, rainbows, storms, snow, the four seasons and the umbrella, raincoat and winter coat that match each kind of day — each with the original flashcard artwork, a drawing canvas, parent scripts and a practice game, plus the weather flashcards and the 35 weather worksheets that go with them.

Open Class 34 ↗
Ages 4–5Class 35

Numbers, Counting & Early Math

Twenty counting lessons — one apple to twenty figs — each card opening its own step-by-step teaching page, with the printable counting cards to deal across the floor and walk like a number line.

Open Class 35 ↗
Ages 4–5Class 36

Animals & Their Habitats

Twenty-two step-by-step habitat lessons — a rabbit in the meadow, a camel between the dunes, a whale under the waves and a bat in the cave — each with the original flashcard artwork, a drawing canvas, parent scripts and a game that puts your child inside the home, plus the printable habitat cards to sort by home.

Open Class 36 ↗
Ages 4–5Class 37

Sports, Movement & Play

Forty step-by-step movement lessons — soccer to swimming, gymnastics to karate — each teaching one big move with the original flashcard artwork, a parent script and a living-room game that grows gross motor skills, physical literacy and the fundamental movement skills of running, jumping, throwing, catching, kicking and balance, plus the printable sports cards to sort by how the body moves.

Open Class 37 ↗
Ages 4–5Class 38

Feelings & Kindness

Thirty-five step-by-step feelings-and-kindness lessons — four words a card: the feeling faces, kind words, calm-down skills and belonging words, from happy, sad, angry and calm to the kindness graduation — each with the original card artwork, a parent script, the questions to ask and one game for tonight, plus the printable feelings cards to sort by how they help.

Open Class 38 ↗

Age ranges are guides, not tests. Start where it is fun, stop while it is fun, and come back whenever you like. Progress saves on this device for the child chosen in My Classroom.
